title: File-service confirmed request trio anchor using FileDirectory
purpose: Add high-number confirmed service coverage on the file-service range using documented tag [77] FileDirectory as a mutation anchor for nearby FileOpen and FileClose paths.
expected_behavior: A parser should decode a Confirmed-Request-PDU and dispatch a high-number confirmed service corresponding to the file-service range, here FileDirectory [77].
constraints_preserved: High-number context-specific service tag [77] is encoded as bf4d.
Small visible-string body provides a concrete mutation base for nearby file services [72], [74], and [77].
issue_safety_notes: This intentionally avoids exact file-service crash payloads while still covering the documented file-service tag range.
